program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to context-alias prediction frontier
question: Can training-only distributional context aliases generalize unseen exact pair surfaces while preserving the fixed 512-state context budget?
hypothesis: Using the exact sealed 512-motif representation and 60/40 external split, induce 16 previous-role aliases from training-only outgoing transition distributions and 32 current-role aliases from training-only incoming transition distributions. Their Cartesian product forms exactly 512 context states. A 512x512 alias-state -> next-motif predictor will improve pooled heldout top-1 accuracy by at least 0.005 over the sealed current-only relation, avoid degrading any source by more than 0.01, and improve the exact-pair overflow/unseen subset by at least 0.02 over the sealed support-backoff predictor.

supersedes_unexecuted_prereg.reason: hourly scheduler created R1 against the scientific implementation SHA before the completed result was evidence-sealed; R2 restores the direct sealed-parent qualification boundary

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Support backoff recovers most exact-pair context damage but exact pair identity remains too brittle to clear the frozen gain threshold; generalize pair surfaces without increasing predictive-state capacity.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.split: first floor(0.60*N) bytes training-only; final 40% suffix scoring-only
frozen_reuse.source_boundaries: reset history per source and never form transitions across sources

alias_induction.previous_role_feature: for each motif ID, its 512-dimensional training-only outgoing successor count vector
alias_induction.current_role_feature: for each motif ID, its 512-dimensional training-only incoming predecessor count vector
alias_induction.normalization: L1 normalize nonzero vectors; all-zero vectors remain all zero
alias_induction.distance: L1 distance over normalized feature vectors
alias_induction.clustering: deterministic farthest-first medoid partition independently for each role
alias_induction.first_medoid: highest training role-occurrence count, tie lowest motif ID
alias_induction.next_medoid: motif maximizing minimum L1 distance to existing medoids, tie higher role-occurrence count then lower motif ID
alias_induction.assignment: nearest medoid by L1 distance, tie lower medoid rank

alias_state.zero_row_fallback: same pooled training successor unigram argmax as sealed relation experiments

comparison_subset.exact_pair_overflow_or_unseen: evaluation pair not in the frozen top-511 exact-pair context dictionary from the sealed backoff parent
comparison_subset.subset_baseline: sealed support-backoff prediction, which uses current-only relation on these queries

diagnostic_metrics: overflow/unseen subset alias and exact-backoff accuracy
alias-state training occupancy and evaluation coverage

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and aliasing improves either pooled accuracy or overflow/unseen accuracy materially but misses at least one frozen gain/nondegradation threshold.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but aliasing does not materially improve either pooled or overflow/unseen accuracy over the frozen controls.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, clustering, capacity, deterministic, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
All motif learning, decoding, source splits, controls, and source-boundary behavior are byte-identical to sealed parents.
Alias features, medoid selection, and assignment use training-prefix data only.
Previous/current alias counts remain exactly 16/32 and Cartesian alias-state count remains exactly 512.
No iterative heldout-driven clustering, dynamic alias creation, or capacity expansion occurs.
All controls and alias predictor score identical heldout suffix triples.
Full Go regression passes before probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, hashes, split, representation, role features, L1 normalization, farthest-first medoid rules, 16x32 alias budget, predictor capacity, controls, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority requirements after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: carry the supported fixed-budget alias state into depth-two/depth-three probability-mass composition

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: separate previous-role and current-role alias contributions before changing representation or capacity
